entry.title: hello, world
entry.content:
A small note to mark the start of this homepage.

I plan to use this blog mostly as a research notebook — quick observations about lattice samplers I’m training, side experiments that didn’t fit into a paper, and pointers to things I’ve been reading. Don’t expect polish; expect process.

If you stumbled here from a paper, the publications page is probably what you want.

写一小段，留作主页落成的记号。

打算把这里当作一本研究笔记：训练格点采样器时的零碎观察、没塞进论文里的小实验、最近在读什么，都丢这里。别指望成稿，看的是过程。

如果你是从某篇论文找过来的，publications 那一页应该更对路。
